response.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink, o.ordertune AS ordertune, f.rebtotal AS rebtotal, f.rebrate AS rebrate, f.feerate AS feerate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault), base AS (SELECT AVG(rebtotal) AS b FROM m), g AS (SELECT orderslink, ordertune, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG((rebrate - feerate) / feerate) AS avg_rel_gap FROM m GROUP BY orderslink, ordertune) SELECT g.orderslink, g.ordertune, g.avg_rebate, g.avg_rel_gap, g.avg_rebate - base.b AS excess_over_baseline FROM g, base WHERE g.avg_rebate > base.b ORDER BY excess_over_baseline DESC LIMIT 10
